Rearranging your dashboard

Every card on the dashboard can be moved, made wider or narrower, or switched off — on the broker side and the agent side, each keeping its own arrangement. Here is the whole thing on a computer, step by step. Nothing you do here can break anything: there is a Reset to default button, and the cards themselves are untouched.

1
Find it

Customise sits just above the cards, on the row under the five dials. It is there on the broker dashboard and on the agent dashboard, and only on the dashboard — open a tab like Deals or Money and it goes away.

2
Press it, and every card gets a panel

Nothing on the cards works while you are in here — each one is covered by its own name and its controls. That is on purpose: in this mode a card is a block you are moving, not a card you are reading.

3
Three controls on every card

The arrows move the card one place earlier or later. The − and + set how many columns wide it is, one to four. Hide this takes it off the dashboard.

4
Or drag it by its name

Press and hold on the card’s name and move the mouse. The card you are dragging goes pale, and the others slide out of the way as you pass over them. Let go where you want it.

5
Make a card wider or narrower

Four columns is the full width of the dashboard. The calendar is 3 by default, Who to call and Needs you are 2, Announcements is 4, everything else is 1. Here Needs you has gone from 2 to 3.

6
Hide what you do not want, and get it back

Anything you hide turns into a chip in a Hidden strip. One press puts it back where it was. Out of edit mode the button reads “Customise” with a count beside it, so you always know something is off rather than missing.

On a phone
The same, with two changes
The arrows point up and down instead of sideways, because there is only one column to be in — and the width control is gone for the same reason. Dragging works with a finger. Everything else is identical.
Without the mouse
Tab and arrow keys
Press Tab until a card’s name is focused, then ← → or ↑ ↓ walk it through the grid one place at a time. The card keeps focus as it moves, so you can keep going.
Where it is kept
This browser, for now
Your arrangement is saved in the browser you made it in, per role — so the broker layout and the agent layout are separate, and your laptop and your phone each keep their own. Nothing is written back to the Hub yet. Making it follow you between devices is a column on the members table and one save call; say the word.
